g.text: py-app-envelope-220x156 | type envelope | trim 220 x 156 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: 21 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: ParkingYou_Envelop_220x156.pdf p1 (RGB (ICC), file claims PDF/X-1a; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 220 x 156 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 226 x 162 mm.
Variabelen: street = Victoriapark 4 ; postcode-city = 5611 BM Eindhoven

Source page 249.28 x 185.28 mm, trim 220 x 156 mm centred (offset 14.64 mm), no BleedBox. The reference is faithful and keeps the crop marks: two stroked paths, white 1.25 pt under black 0.25 pt (registration spot All in the source). OPEN POINT: the marks sit at 11.64 and 237.64 mm, i.e. 3 mm OUTSIDE the trim, at the bleed edge of a 226 x 162

mm area, and not at the trim edge; marks that are normally set to the trim would be at 14.64 and 234.64 mm. Confirm with the printer whether the 3 mm is meant as the bleed and which edge the marks refer to. The template has no crop marks (the printer's system adds them), 3 mm bleed (white, the envelope has no bleed content), coordinates

relative to the trim. Lockup: py-comp-lockup-logo-tagline-color at scale 0.652 (beeldmerk 15.6 x 18.9 mm at x 20.39, y 18.23 relative to the trim, page 35.0, 32.9), then the address line comp below it (Ubuntu Light 2.47 mm, text origin x 40.64, baseline 58.1 minus 14.64 = 43.46 mm from the trim top, aligned with the wordmark left edge).
